messages:
Sam R.: Dropping the pen-test + vuln-scan package for Acme's vendor review. Contents: pen-test.pdf, nessus_export.xml, nmap.txt, remediation-tracker.csv, per-issue screenshots, and a draft attestation. S3: https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/artifacts/acme_security_artifacts_1786301122.zip
SHA256: f2d6c3b1a9e4f7c8d0b1a2c3e4f5d6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e

SecurityBot: Scan summary: Tools = Nessus Pro & nmap 7.93. Findings: 0 CRITICAL, 3 HIGH, 9 MEDIUM, 4 LOW. Exported CSV includes CVE refs and suggested mitigations. :mag:

Tina P.: Thx Sam. Sales wants a column with remediation owner, responsible team, and an ETA (YYYY-MM-DD). Also Acme asked for an attestation signed by InfoSec and a short customer-facing summary. Can we provide signed evidence?

Sam R.: I added owner/team/ETA into remediation-tracker.csv. Example rows pasted below; full file updated in zip.
```
issue_id,summary,severity,owner,team,eta
VT-1001,Admin UI default creds,HIGH,Jordan M.,Platform Security,2026-04-05
VT-1007,TLS v1.0 supported,MEDIUM,Infra Team,Infrastructure,2026-04-10
VT-1012,Missing X-Frame-Options,LOW,Web Eng,Frontend,2026-04-12
```

Signed attestation: we can produce an InfoSec-signed PDF attestation addressed to "Acme Corp (security@acme.example)" stating no customer data exposure observed. Draft is in /attestation/acme_attestation_draft.pdf inside the zip.

Jordan M.: Quick on VT-1001: admin default creds found on a dev instance that accidentally remained in prod tag set. Plan: rotate creds, revoke session tokens, remove dev tag from prod images. I can push the rotation tomorrow night. ETA 2026-04-05 is conservative to include verification. Evidence: VT-1001-creds-screenshot.png + auth-logs-2026-03-22.txt

Tina P.: Please also add change request ID and pager-oncall contact for the ETA window. Customer wants assurance on data exposure — can confirm no PII was found in collected evidence?

Sam R.: Added CHG-8019 as change request link and pager: oncall@redwood.com (Pager: Jordan M.). Confirmed: no PII or customer data in exported artifacts per initial scan. Attestation will include that statement. I will GPG-sign the attestation and add PDF timestamp. New zip link (versioned): https://redwood-inference.s3.amazonaws.com/artifacts/acme_security_artifacts_1786301122_v2.zip
New SHA256: b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2

Jordan M.: Added remediation commands for VT-1007 (TLS):
```
# apt on ubuntu hosts
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install --only-upgrade openssl -y
# nginx config: disable TLSv1 TLSv1.1
ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
```
I'll run verification tests and attach openssl and nmap verification outputs to evidence.

Tina P.: Sales wants a 2-sentence customer summary for the email: can someone draft? Also note we'll promise a 48-hour SLA for clarifying follow-ups after deliver.

Sam R.: Draft summary: "Redwood completed an external penetration test and vulnerability scan for your environment. We identified several issues (high and medium) and have provided remediation ownership, timelines, and supporting evidence; an InfoSec-signed attestation confirming no customer data exposure is included." Use at your discretion.

Tina P.: Good. I'll send to Acme tomorrow 08:00 PT and include CHG-8019 and oncall contact. Will set follow-up reminder for 48 hours. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

SecurityBot: Reminder: security artifacts retention = 90 days. If legal requires longer retention for this customer, open ticket in #legal-retention.

Jordan M.: I'll validate the tracker and thumbs-up after the nightly run.

Sam R.: Keeping the S3 object versioned until legal signs off. Ping me in #sales if anything else. Closing thread unless further edits.
